official_conformance.evidence: The official conformance repository documents server mode as `server --url http://...`; it does not provide a local-stdio server runner for this P0 contract. No temporary HTTP proxy was introduced or counted as stdio evidence. Source: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/conformance.

codex_three_host_e2e.evidence: Requires user-facing Codex Desktop, CLI and IDE sessions.

limitations: MCP003 remains read-only; candidate mutation, reference bytes, Skill Registry, quality compiler and permanent version confirmation are MCP004+.
The protocol adapter and configuration baselines are verified locally; an authenticated Codex CLI read-only model turn passed, while Desktop/IDE host rows and official conformance remain unrun.
MCP resource contents are bounded JSON projections; binary CAS/resource links and render passes remain later capability gates.
MCP 2026-07-28 modern stateless discovery is explicitly unsupported in MCP003; it requires a separate adapter and must not be silently downgraded.
